I rewrote `message.md`, and no other files were changed:

> The export scheduled for 14:00 UTC has been delayed and will be ready by 16:00 UTC. Your existing data is unaffected, and we'll email you as soon as the export is ready.

All four facts are still there: the 14:00 UTC export is delayed, it will be ready by 16:00 UTC, existing data is unaffected, and an email will go out when it's ready.

I took out the all-caps "THIS IS A DELAY, DO NOT PANIC." It doesn't add a new fact, and the calmer wording now carries that reassurance. If you want a short reassuring line kept, I can add one back.
